# @mdevs/ui

> 1212 independent named React/TypeScript exports. 132 primitives and 1080 domain components (108 domains × 10 shared patterns). Liquid Glass CSS, explicit contracts, ESM/CJS/types.

- [Consolidated guides](llms-full.txt)

Start with AGENTS and a limited manifest search. Open catalog/components/<category>/<slug>.md for the chosen export: exact props, callbacks, defaults, models, real behavior and a complete React example. Domain catalog/<category>/README.md lists its ten families, statuses and settings. Follow public package exports; inspect src or dist declarations to resolve ambiguity. initialValues is a mount-time form default; filters/settings are controlled; network and async error management belong to the host app. Maintenance scripts mentioned in guides require the monorepo.

Import @mdevs/ui/styles.css once. Use ThemeProvider for scoped theme and portal tokens. Read each source/declaration before inventing props. Domain data and callbacks belong to the application; examples are fixtures. No color/size variants counted as separate components.

- [Creation/style rules](STYLE.md)
- [0.2 component extension guide](catalog/docs/EXTENSIONS.md)

Approved default: local Inter WOFF2 (UI), subtle 12px glass blur, monochrome black/white icons with 1.5px rounded strokes. Preserve asset licences. New entries must have a real contract and distinct purpose/geometry; sizes/colors/aliases do not count.
